plain: In 2004, off the coast of San Diego, ships and jets of a group led by the aircraft carrier USS Nimitz tracked a white oval object shaped like a Tic Tac mint. Michels says it was seen on radar, by eyewitnesses including the Navy pilot David Fravor, and on infrared camera footage that was later released, with 11 or 12 witnesses over three days. Michels makes this case himself in several episodes, holding it up as some of the strongest UFO evidence because so many different kinds of sensors caught it at once.
